name: time-machine-stack
title: Time Machine Stack
description: A stack that reaches back through time: older cards peek out above the front one, and Newer, Older or the arrow keys step through them.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; content: ReactNode }[]

props.name: index
props.description: Controlled index of the card in front.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the new front index.

props.name: visibleCount
props.description: Cards visible behind the front one.

props.name: offsetY
props.description: Vertical step in pixels between stacked cards.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the stack area. Give it a size.
